class.name: IfcBoundedCurve
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A bounded curve is a curve of finite arc length with identifiable end points. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 name: bounded_curve, only the following subtypes have been incorporated into IFC: polyline as IfcPolyline , trimmed_curve as IfcTrimmedCurve , composite_curve as IfcCompositeCurve . Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p.44 for the final definition of t
